$comment.namespace: Story 11b.4 — the family memorial (the nominee writes, for the family). Grief-paced (fursat): no deadlines, no counts of steps, no pressure. Every refusal is Pattern 4: what happened, what to do, the helpline. The family's own words are never touched by this copy. Agent-drafted; the AC14 tone review is RECORDED, not assumed.
entry.title: A few words about them
entry.body: When you feel ready, you can write about them for the family. There is no hurry.
entry.a11y: Write a few words about the member, for the family
intro.prompt: Would you like to share a few words about {name}?
intro.prompt_no_name: Would you like to share a few words about them?
intro.body: You can write over days if you need. Your words stay on this phone until you send them to the Trust.
intro.start: Yes, I would like to write
header.save_and_come_back_a11y: Save what you have written and come back later
draft.kept_on_phone: Your writing is kept on this phone only. It does not move to another phone.
draft.photo_missing: The photo you chose earlier is no longer on this phone. You can choose it again if you like.
write.title: Your words
write.label: What would you like to say about them?
write.hint: Write in Hindi or English, in your own way. Leave a blank line to begin a new paragraph.
write.over_limit: This is a little longer than the page can hold. Please shorten it by about {count} letters.
photo.title: A photo, if you wish
photo.body: You can add one photo. The Trust will see it before anyone else does.
photo.use_previous: Use the photo I sent before
photo.alt_label: Describe the photo in a few words
photo.alt_hint: This tells people who cannot see the photo what it shows.
photo.alt_over_limit: This description is a little longer than the page can hold. Please shorten it by about {count} letters.
photo.permission_denied: We could not open your photos. You can allow it in your phone's settings, or continue without a photo.
photo.kept_note: The photo you sent before will be used again.
$comment.family: Story 11b.5a (KL8, copy Q-copy-2 — APPROVED by BigDev 2026-10-31) — the family list, optional, the nominee only. Each relation is relative to THE MEMBER WHO DIED. The family is told where the list appears (-391 item 2; -428 rider) and, under -426, that a child may be named only by their parent or guardian or with their agreement. hiReviewed waits on a non-author review (Row 41 (s)).
family.title: Their family, if you wish
family.body: You can list the family they leave behind, as an obituary does. It is up to you.
family.where_shown: The list will appear with your words on the member's Sahyog Vivran page (which anyone with its link can read) and to members in the app.
family.children_guardian: You may name a child only if you are their parent or guardian, or have their parent's or guardian's agreement. You will be asked to confirm this before you send.
family.relation_question: For each person, choose how they are related to the member.
family.name_hint: One person on each line, written as you would like it to appear.
family.name_over_limit: This name is a little long for the page. Please shorten it by about {count} letters.
family.row_incomplete: Please choose a relation and write a name for each person, or remove that line.
family.limit_reached: You have listed {count} people, which is as many as the page can hold.
family.start_from_sent: Start from the list I sent
family.in_photo_hint: If you added a photo, you can tick who in your list appears in it. This helps the Trust; it is not shown under the photo.
preview.before_publish: Once it is published, anyone may see this memorial. If you would like to change anything, now is the best time.
preview.title: How it will read
preview.no_family_list: This version has no family list. The list you sent before will not appear.
handover.title: A code for the nominee
handover.body: To send, we will text a code to the nominee's phone ({masked}). Please type it here.
handover.code_label: The code sent to the nominee
handover.send_failed: We could not send the code just now. Your writing is safe on this phone. Please try again in a little while, or call the helpline.
handover.no_nominee: We could not find the nominee for this account. Your writing is safe on this phone. Please call the helpline and we will help you send it.
handover.not_verified: That code did not match. Please check the code and type it again.
$comment.handover.resend: Review Z0 (A), 2026-10-24 — "Send a new code" on the nominee-code panel (shown when the SMS failed, or after a wait; never without a nominee). Agent-drafted and UN-ATTESTED: the AC14 non-author (Hindi) review owes handover.resend and handover.resend_note, like the rest.
handover.resend_note: We can send a new code to the nominee's phone.
handover.still_refused: We could not send it this time. Your writing is safe on this phone. Please call the helpline and we will help.
send.body_blank: There are no words to send yet. Please write a few words, then send.
send.body_too_long: This is a little longer than the page can hold. Please shorten it a little, then send.
send.alt_text_required: Please describe the photo in a few words, so that people who cannot see it know what it shows.
send.alt_text_too_long: The photo description is a little long. Please shorten it, then send.
send.photo_type: We could not use this photo. Please choose a different photo, or send without one.
send.photo_unreadable: We could not read this photo. Please choose a different photo, or send without one.
send.photo_too_large: This photo is too large to send. Please choose a smaller photo, or send without one.
send.photo_conflict: Please choose either a new photo or the photo you sent before.
send.no_previous_photo: We could not find the photo you sent before. Please choose a photo again, or send without one.
send.already_reviewed: The Trust has already approved what you sent. To change it, please call the helpline.
send.authorisation_outdated: The permission text has been updated. Please read it again, then send.
send.nominee_unresolved: We could not find the nominee for this account, so we could not send it. Your writing is safe on this phone. Please call the helpline and we will help.
send.try_again: We could not send it this time. Your writing is safe on this phone. Please try again in a little while.
send.kinship_invalid: We could not read the family list. Please check that each person has a relation and a name, then send again.
send.generic: We could not send it this time. Your writing is safe on this phone. Please try again in a little while, or call the helpline.
outcome.title: About your words
outcome.with_the_trust: Your words are with the Trust. They will read them and let you know here.
outcome.replace_note: If you write again, the new version replaces the one with the Trust.
outcome.withdrawn: You withdrew it. You can write again whenever you wish.
outcome.approved: The Trust approved your words as you wrote them. They will appear on the member's Sahyog Vivran page.
outcome.approved_with_omissions: The Trust approved your words and left out a part, marked below. On the member's Sahyog Vivran page the part left out is simply not there — nothing marks where it was.
outcome.alt_text_left_out: A part of the photo description was left out.
outcome.kinship_left_out: Left out of the family list: {relation} — {name}
outcome.not_approved: The Trust could not approve these words.
outcome.approval_withdrawn: The Trust has withdrawn its approval of your words.
outcome.taken_down: At the nominee's request, the helpline has taken your words down. They are no longer on the member's Sahyog Vivran page. You can write again whenever you wish.
outcome.earlier_approval_withdrawn: The Trust withdrew its approval of an earlier version.
outcome.earlier_approval_stands: The version the Trust approved earlier still stands. If you would like to change it, you can write a new version for the Trust to look at, or call the helpline.
outcome.earlier_approval_stands_helpline: The version the Trust approved earlier still stands. To change it, the nominee can call the helpline.
outcome.reason_child_undeclared: it names or shows a child your confirmation cannot cover
outcome.helpline_for_changes: If you, the nominee, ever want it changed or taken down, please call the helpline.
outcome.helpline: You can talk to us on the helpline at any time.
outcome.unavailable: We cannot show your words just now. Please try again in a little while.
outcome.withdraw_failed: We could not take it back just now. It is still with the Trust. Please try again in a little while, or call the helpline.
view_missing.body: We could not open this just now. Anything you have written is safe on this phone. Please try again, or call the helpline.
view_missing.body_outcome: We could not open this just now. Please try again, or call the helpline.
reason.attacks_someone_named: it speaks against a person by name
reason.accuses_someone_of_wrongdoing: it says someone did something wrong
reason.against_the_law: it may be against the law
reason.identifies_a_child: it names or shows a child
$comment.kinship: Story 11b.5a (KL3 / KL9 / copy 5.1-5.2 — APPROVED by BigDev 2026-10-31) — the ONE home of the family list's labels: the mobile picker, preview and outcome AND the public page read these keys (no copy in sahyog-vivran). Each is the relation TO THE MEMBER WHO DIED. English plurals (_plural) are used when a relation has two or more names; in Hindi the masculine words read correctly for one or more (their _plural keys carry the same word) while the five feminine ones take their plural forms (code review round 3, DN1, BigDev 2026-11-01).
